audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts are wrong on five of seven rows. Level 1 was scored Gangplank while whys[0] calls it 'a coin-flip you should not start'; levels 2 and 3 were Skill while whys[1]/whys[2] say 'Volibear hits his dive spike first' and 'Still his window'; levels 4-5 and first item were Skill while whys[3] and whys[5] say you take over there.
audit.why: 54.13% over 593 games: you lose the 2-3 dive window and own everything from the second keg point onward. The packet chart (Skill, Volibear, Volibear, Gangplank, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank) matches the prose row for row.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to the packet chart, ratings rescaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Stormbringer and Sky Splitter never appear in the full layer at all — phases[4].why is generic boilerplate about 'Volibear's ultimate changes the math too'.
audit.why: His R disables your tower on landing and grants bonus health; his E shields him only if he is standing inside the blast. Both change what level 6 actually is, and neither was stated.
audit.corrected: Both written into phases[4].why and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup says 'Cleanse it with Q' in dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t. Gangplank's cleanse is W, Remove Scurvy; Parrrley cleanses nothing. Frenzied Maul's 5s cooldown and on-hit application are never mentioned, nor is his Q's 12s cooldown.
audit.why: A player holding Q for the stun eats it every time. And Frenzied Maul at 5s means an extended trade is a heal war, not a burst race — attack speed from The Relentless Storm makes armour read the trade too optimistically.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy named as the cleanse; 12s Q and 5s on-hit W written into the do's and don'ts; anti-heal put on the W line.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content 'mid' and 'late' paragraphs are written in FIRST PERSON — 'This is where it flips to me', 'Once I have a second Powder Keg', 'I own this long-term', 'my W cleanses'.
audit.why: The whole site is second-person coaching voice. This one matchup breaks it, which reads as a different author and undermines trust in the page.
audit.corrected: Both paragraphs converted to second person and the real cooldown numbers added while keeping length inside the band.

edits.before: Q-poke costs him HP and pays you gold. Identify how Volibear contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Frenzied Maul is a 5s bite that heals him, so short trades go his way. Don't open a level 1 you cannot finish.

edits.before: First barrel chains start zoning his wave positions. Only take the trade when Volibear's Thundering Smash is down.
edits.after: His spike, not yours: Thundering Smash dashes in and stuns on a 12s cooldown before a single keg is armed.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Thundering Smash's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Second keg point lets you Parrrley-into-keg from outside his 300-range dash — a Volibear on a 12s Q eats the slow walking in.

edits.before: Cannon Barrage wins fights you are not even in — watch the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Volibear's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Even at 6: Stormbringer disables your tower, but Cannon Barrage zones the leap and Sky Splitter only shields him inside its own blast.

edits.before: Chain a barrel behind the wave, Q-pop it as Volibear steps to farm, and orange away whatever he answers with.
edits.after: Chain a barrel behind the wave, Q-pop it as Volibear steps to farm, and Remove Scurvy his stun if he dashes.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Trading into a fresh Thundering Smash — the stun lands, Frenzied Maul heals, and you lose the exchange.

edits.before: His engage. Cleanse it with Q. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His engage, 12s at rank 1. Remove Scurvy (W) cures that stun, not Q.

edits.before: Volibear wastes Thundering Smash (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Remove Scurvy cures the stun and heals — hold it for his dash, not poke.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Frenzied Maul is a 5s on-hit bite that heals — get Oblivion Orb.

edits.before: Letting him pop your barrels for free — every broken keg is gold and tempo handed across the lane.
edits.after: Stormbringer disables your tower and hands him bonus health — never be low near turret at 6.

edits.before: This is where it flips to me. Once I have a second Powder Keg (E) and Parrrley point I start landing Q-into-keg poke from outside his Q dash range, and a Volibear whose dash is on cooldown has to eat the keg slow to reach me. At 6 I use Cannon Barrage (R) to zone the all-in, but the real edge is W: I cleanse his Q stun the instant he dashes onto me, heal the bite, and walk away from a blown engage. Bait the dash, keg-poke on its cooldown, and never trade into a fresh empowered Q.

Once you have a second Powder Keg (E) and Parrrley point you land Q-into-keg poke from outside his 300-range dash, and a Volibear whose Q is on its 12s cooldown has to eat the keg slow to reach you. At 6 use Cannon Barrage (R) to zone the all-in, but the real edge is W: cleanse his Q stun the instant he dashes onto you, heal the bite, and walk away from a blown engage. Bait the dash, keg-poke on its cooldown, and never trade into a fresh empowered Q.

edits.before: I own this long-term. Volibear scales as a diving bruiser-tank, but he has no answer to a full keg chain — chained Powder Keg detonations and empowered Parrrley burst him through his bulk, and my W cleanses the one piece of hard CC (his Q stun) he brings to a fight. His R leap disables a tower and shields him for the dive, so don't get caught alone under turret, but in a straight side-lane 1v1 my barrels and global Cannon Barrage pressure beat his all-in every time. Close it out before he stacks six items of tank stats and just chunks through me.
edits.after: You own this long-term. Volibear scales as a diving bruiser-tank, but he has no answer to a full keg chain — chained Powder Keg detonations and empowered Parrrley burst him through his bulk, and Remove Scurvy cleanses the one piece of hard CC (his Q stun) he brings to a fight. His R leap disables a tower and hands him bonus health for the dive, so don't get caught alone under turret, and buy Grievous Wounds early so Frenzied Maul stops refilling him every five seconds. In a side-lane 1v1 your barrels and global Cannon Barrage beat his all-in. Close it before he stacks six items of tank stats.

notes: Packet suspect name 'Powder Kegs' is a false positive (plural of the correct name). Not asserted: whether Remove Scurvy's cleanse can be used pre-emptively against Thundering Smash's stun or only after it lands — Riot's text says 'cure crowd control effects' and nothing about immunity, so the advice is written as cleansing after the dash connects.
